LIMITS OF INTERPRETATION

Completar un acoplamiento no demuestra actividad ni afinidad experimental.
Las poses de esta cohorte no han superado todavía una validación geométrica/física automática; una afinidad sólo es interpretable después de revisar la pose.
La afinidad Vina observada es una señal de ranking dentro de este protocolo, no una medida de energía libre.
No hay puntuación agregada ni ranking de candidatos: este resumen no ordena moléculas por mérito farmacológico.
Las filas `failed` y `not_evaluated` no son evidencia negativa sobre sus moléculas: describen lo que le pasó al motor.

Receptors whose crystal pose was reproduced and whose calibration was measured against experimental data. Each one shows its figures.

There are no verified receptors in this version yet. We will verify them one by one, and each will be published with its figures.

Published attempts

Receptors measured with the protocol that did not pass it. They remain in Demo; they are published so you know what was measured.

8HFI · CRYO-EM STRUCTURE OF HUMAN NOREPINEPHRINE TRANSPORTER NET IN THE

Did not pass calibration: ρ = 0.13 (95% CI: -0.16–0.41; n = 57; Ki, CHEMBL853189). Vina's ranking cannot be distinguished from chance on this panel.

Crystal pose reproduced in 3 of 5 seeds (RMSD ≤ 2 Å)

Measured with exhaustiveness 8, 9 poses and seed 42. Not measured with other parameters.

The receptor was docked without the deposited ions (preparation removes them). Vina has no electrostatic term; the calibration was measured under these conditions.

The panel is almost entirely one analogue series: ρ describes how it ranks compounds of that series, not structurally diverse ligands.

The assay conditions (pH, temperature, radioligand) are not documented in the sources consulted; the correlation is within a single assay.

Top-1 RMSD by seed: 0.6, 0.5, 4.1, 0.6, 3.7 Å.

Sealed experiment: CAL-8HFI-01 (2026-10-09).
